They will go from the front and the back. You will have to defend yourself on both sides. But there will also be danger from heaven. From there you will be attacked by zombie bats and other creatures. Try to kill them all and get as far as you can.
instructions: Use mouse to aim and shoot

title: Neon Snake Classic
description: “Neon Snake Game” is a casual and fun game, inspired by one of the first mobile games ever made.Your goal is to reach as many points as possible and save to your device.Have fun in this neon style game, very fun!
instructions: On the computer use the W-A-S-D on your keyboard to move the snake On mobile devices use the touch just slide your finger in the directions you want the snake to move

title: Among Us Crazy Shooter
description: There are imposters among us! Quickly move around on the building, avoiding all of the enemy bullets, while you shoot down the bad guys on the other side. Remove all of the enemies to complete each level in this crazy online Among Us themed shooter game. Unlock new guns as you attempt to beat all 20 challenging levels.
